title: Palace Map — rich

pieces.title: Growth rings
pieces.caption: The palace cut across like a trunk. Each dot is a page, oldest at the heart, coloured by its type; each ring is a month of 2026. March is the widest ring, 105 pages. *What is real and what is a choice:* 328 of the map's 329 pages, placed by the birth date each gives itself (one gives none). Map build of 2026-11-09.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch B (counts from the map and git) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.why: True to its data and the trunk is a real metaphor, not only a chart; legible at margin width (dots and ring labels hold, the footer is small). Two notes: the sentence beside it is about the map's size, and the page never talks about when pages were born, so the piece adds a claim the page does not make; and the in-image line "A wide ring was a fat month" is loose, because count is drawn as ring area, not width (June's 49 pages make a ring about as wide as January's 11).
